info.title: CoCIS Smart Control & Monitoring API
info.description: Database API for the ESP32 access-control, occupancy and lighting system (Embedded Systems coursework, Makerere University, 2026/2027).

post.description:
Online path: the ESP32 sends a scan, the server decides, records it and
answers in one transaction. The ESP32 opens the door only on GRANTED.
A person crossed a lecture-room doorway (IR beams), or the lights changed.

Offline path: records queued on the SD card while Wi-Fi was down.
The decision was already made by the ESP32, so we store it as-is.
Duplicate event_uuids are skipped, so re-sending a batch is always safe.

get.description: Everything the ESP32 caches on its SD card to decide offline.

post.description: Periodic 'I am alive'. Reply tells the ESP32 whether to re-download config.

delete.description: Soft delete: the tag stops working but history is kept for the records.

put.description:
Manual override, e.g. force LR1 lights off during a power-saving period.
AUTO returns control to the IR beam occupancy counter. The ESP32 picks this up on its next config pull.
Fire / evacuation: unlock every door regardless of schedule.

occupant_count.title: Occupant Count
occupant_count.description: People in the room, from the IR beam counter
